curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: advocate for the need to follow spelling rules for writing fluency.

mission.title: advocate for the need to follow spelling rules for writing fluency.

interactions.prompt: Which label clearly names the picture of a sun?
interactions.feedback: Yes! Correct spelling makes the word easy to read.
interactions.retryHint: Say /s/ /u/ /n/ and find every sound in order.

interactions.prompt: Which sentence is easiest to read?
interactions.feedback: Correct spelling lets us read smoothly.
interactions.retryHint: Check each word from left to right.

interactions.prompt: Help fix the sign ‘WASH YOR HANDS’. Which word should replace YOR?
interactions.feedback: Great editing! The clear sign says WASH YOUR HANDS.
interactions.retryHint: The word your has the letters y-o-u-r.

interactions.prompt: Choose the correctly spelled message for a friend.
interactions.feedback: Well done! Your friend can understand the message quickly.
interactions.retryHint: Look for complete familiar words: please, bring, your, book.

interactions.prompt: A classmate asks why spelling rules matter. Choose the best answer.
interactions.feedback: Exactly! Good spelling helps ideas move clearly from writer to reader.
interactions.retryHint: Think about what helps a reader understand.

interactions.prompt: What should you encourage a friend to do before sharing a sentence?
interactions.feedback: Excellent advice! Checking spelling builds fluent writing.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the careful strategy that improves the writing.
